main_text.p: cio aptatum & coagmenta-tum est, ut eius partē efficiat? Vlpianus, & alij innumerabiles respondent, dici:legemq; XII tabularū ita intelligendam esse. Nos in Institutionibus, multis uerbis disputauimus, doctissimisque uiris sententiam nostrā probauimus, legem duodecim Tabularū de tignis tantū locutam esse, quæ uel uineis, uel ædibus fulciendis tēporis causa, non autem in perpetuum adijciūtur. Aliud exemplum. Lex est: Qui maiestatē minuerit, pœnas luito. Q. Cæpionis proconsulis temeritate maxima clades accepta erat: Nor

page.notes: Right margin: small marks (a dash, an apostrophe-like tick, a "<" sign) beside the lines "de tignis" and "tur. Aliud"; uncertain whether printed or ink, so not transcribed as notes. The handwritten "Aliud exemplum" in the right margin is manuscript and not transcribed. The first line begins mid-word ("cio"), a fragment from the previous page. Printed text "efficiat?" and "dici:legemq;" kept as printed.
